purpose: Technical packet shape and concise reminders of existing pinned process; no new semantic rules, authorizations or quality credit. Scope/baseline/ownedpath in each native assignment remain authoritative.
mutable: All text including answer labels and source metadata may be source-backed rewritten. Preserve good wording. Read FULL prompt with every answer and its own note. Frozen correctIndex is not evidence for the key.
semanticChecks: Personally read every field and full relevant primary context, including every distractor/note. Saved full bodies reused, not redownloaded/copied perpacket; snippet/search/HTTP200/hash alone never source proof.

One key, plausible same-category alternatives, Russian grammar, correct absolute adult level. HARD specific knowledge OR substantive/multistep logic; MEDIUM thematic familiarity; EASY broad adult knowledge. No arbitrary mandatory math.

Correct note adds a concrete own-option fact beyond its own prompt+key; overlap with explanation allowed. Wrong notes teach their own option and may use canonical facts keyed elsewhere. No cross-note ban.

MAIN semantic duplicates checked by entity-relation-value-context/direct reverse in topic and relevant cross-catalog peers. Actual CURRENT peers and both sides of all proposed relevant pairs, including separate simultaneous proposals.

Each literal group and each of four prompt-answer-note variants requires substantive claim-to-source grounds and exact locator. Repeating meaningful grounds is allowed; generic source-support templates are not evidence.
